exact_static_merge.budget_selection_scope: Per collector, descending (independent original source-cell calls - 1) / expanded bytes; world budget shared, collector construction order unchanged
exact_static_merge.cell_policy: Original H07 spatial bins; merge across shape keys within the original cell/material domain
exact_static_merge.custom0_policy: RGB_FLOAT, three unnormalized float32 values per vertex: original instance basis * source NORMAL
exact_static_merge.expanded_geometry_estimate: Conservative CPU/GPU payload estimate includes 12-byte CUSTOM0 allowance for every accepted vertex, including unoutlined vertices
exact_static_merge.glass_scope: Pinned opaque isotropic PBR glass from H07 default _make_batch only; no lightmap/capture, instance GI, instance uniform or custom MultiMesh data
exact_static_merge.normal_transform: normalize(instance_basis * source_normal), matching Godot4.7.2 Forward+ MultiMesh under an identity parent
exact_static_merge.scope: Static draw-node equivalence only. Actual pixels and performance require native same-view checks.
exact_static_merge.tangent_policy: Input tangents are not retained byte-for-byte. Godot rebuilds unused tangents; the pinned paint and isotropic glass shaders consume no TANGENT, BINORMAL, NORMAL_MAP or ANISOTROPY semantics.
